name: @civ-clone/ui-models-hosted
description: The sets of models that ship with civ.one for the 3D map, served beside the game: 0 A.D.'s ancient units (civ-clone/models-0ad, CC BY-SA 3.0, by Wildfire Games) and Cimpletoon's later units (civ-clone/models-cimpletoon, CC0 1.0, by yd), each a dependency of the renderer. The build reads their manifests (civ-clone.hostedModels); the page imports only where they are.
